buildings.name: Village Hall
buildings.description: The lord's hall and its mead-benches. 500 gold a day.

buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.description: Tolls and market dues. 1000 gold a day.

buildings.name: City Hall
buildings.description: The seat of the march. 2000 gold a day.

buildings.name: Fort
buildings.description: A timber palisade. Needed for the heavier dwellings.

buildings.name: Hillfort
buildings.description: Earth ramparts and a stone gate. Recruits grow 50% faster; the nobles will come.

buildings.name: High Seat
buildings.description: The seat of a British king. Recruits grow twice as fast.

buildings.name: Marketplace
buildings.description: Trade resources: sell at half value, buy at one and a half.

buildings.name: Painting Stones
buildings.description: Where the Cruths paint their first stripe. Woad Runners gather here.

buildings.name: Sling Range
buildings.description: Shepherds practise on the hillside. Cruth Slingers gather here.

buildings.name: Blade Circle
buildings.description: A ring of standing stones where the Painted Blades duel for their stripes.

buildings.name: Horse Lines
buildings.description: Paddocks for the Gododdin Riders' mounts.

buildings.name: Mead Hall
buildings.description: Where the lord's household drinks his mead, and swears the Teulu's oath.

buildings.name: Boasting Ring
buildings.description: Warriors boast of deeds to come. While you hold this town, your troops fight with +1 attack.

buildings.name: Slingers' Cairn
buildings.description: Slingers keep watch from the cairn: while you hold this town, your shooters fire once a round at any enemy that moves closer, before it strikes.

Hallowmere.title: Seat of House Hale  ·  lent to you by Corvin
